attributes.name: Druva - Sandbox Recovery Failed
attributes.description: Detects failed restore or recovery activity involving a sandbox or isolated recovery environment.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects failed restore or recovery activity involving a sandbox or isolated recovery environment.

attributes.query:
(
  message:*sandbox*
  or druva.resource.type:*sandbox*
)
and (
  message:*recover*
  or message:*restore*
)
and (
  event.outcome:"failure"
  or event.outcome:"failure"
  or message:*failed*
)
